items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: The interviewer mentions Willie Junior in the context of the Humphrey family musicians (Willie Senior, Jim Humphrey), but the interviewee does not respond with any personal interaction or relationship details regarding Willie Junior.

ctx.x: Willie Senior plays clarinet. Yeah. He's still alive. And the young boy. Young Willie, he's with Paul Barberin. Jim Humphrey was the name of the old grandfather. The trumpet player. Oh, what, his daddy? Yeah. We call him Mr. Willie.
No, listen, there's Willie Junior, he plays clarinet. Willie Senior plays clarinet, and the grandfather named Jim Humphrey, and the grandfather named
Jim Humphrey, and the grandfather named Jim Humphrey, and the grandfather named Jim Humphrey played trumpet. I know that.
